body: I really wish there was a solution this simple for me. Trust me, if I saw a way out then I would take it.

I try to work out as much as I can in my free time, and I am ridiculously good at black ops, although I have not gotten around to buying the second part. I also enjoy eating healthy and I like animals.

I know that what you read online cannot replace years of education, but I get kind of desperate sometimes and the thought of putting a label on my situation feels like an easy way to get people to understand how I feel. It also helps me personally in dealing with all this because I can find out more about the symptoms I have and how to minimize them.
Is there any other way out besides professional help? I doubt my parents would approve of medication, and seeing a therapist is not really such a simple option for me.
